note: The durable error-code table for the schema-1 envelope. Codes may be added, never renamed or removed. One code per operator-distinguishable failure family; the envelope's command field carries the which-command context. 'folded' records finer inventory names that map onto a shipped family code. 'legacy' maps the three pre-envelope conventions (snake_case ready.json codes, PascalCase error names, kebab-case doctor check ids) onto the table.

E_ARGS.summary: A required argument is missing or the invocation is malformed.

E_INVALID_OPTION.summary: A flag or argument value is not in the accepted set.

E_FLAG_NOT_SUPPORTED_HERE.summary: The flag exists but does not apply to this command or target.

E_REMOVED_FLAG.summary: The flag was removed from the CLI.

E_UNKNOWN_COMMAND.summary: No subcommand matches the given name.

E_NODE_VERSION.summary: The running Node version is below the supported minimum.

E_COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_TARGET.summary: The command does not support the requested browser target.

E_UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER.summary: The requested vendor is not in the supported browser list.

E_BROWSER_NOT_INSTALLABLE.summary: The browser ships with the OS and cannot be installed by the CLI.

E_PARENT_GONE.summary: The --parent-pid owner died, so the dev server self-terminated.

E_REMOTE_URL_UNSUPPORTED.summary: The operation does not accept a remote URL.

E_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.summary: The resolved project folder does not exist.

E_MANAGED_DEP_CONFLICT.summary: The project declares a package the toolchain manages.

E_TSCONFIG_MISSING.summary: TypeScript sources exist with no tsconfig.json beside package.json.

E_OPTIONAL_DEP_UNRESOLVED.summary: An optional dependency contract could not be resolved.

E_OPTIONAL_DEP_LOAD.summary: An optional dependency resolved but failed to load.

E_COMPANION_EXTENSION_PATH.summary: A companion extension path escapes extensions/ or yielded nothing unpacked.

E_RUNTIME_NOT_FOUND.summary: The extension-develop runtime is missing or uncompiled.

E_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND.summary: No manifest.json at the resolved root.

E_MANIFEST_INVALID.summary: The manifest is not parseable JSON or not a WebExtension manifest.

E_MANIFEST_SHAPE.summary: A manifest field has the wrong shape.

E_MANIFEST_PAGE_MISSING.summary: A manifest-referenced HTML page does not exist.

E_MANIFEST_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.summary: The manifest_version is not supported on this target.

E_MANIFEST_LOAD_BLOCKERS.summary: Manifest fields the browser will reject at load time.

E_MANIFEST_PERMISSION_MISSING.summary: A required permission is absent from the manifest.

E_MANIFEST_MSG_KEY_MISSING.summary: A __MSG_x__ key is absent from the default locale.

E_RESTART_REQUIRED.summary: An entrypoint field changed and the dev server must restart.

E_FIRST_COMPILE.summary: The first compile of a session failed, so nothing was loaded.

E_COMPILE_FATAL.summary: The compiler itself failed or returned unusable stats.

E_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.summary: A module specifier could not be resolved.

E_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.summary: A manifest, HTML, or JSON entry points at a missing file.

E_ASSET_MISSING.summary: An icon, static asset, or JSON dependency is missing.

E_SCRIPT_DEP_MISSING.summary: A runtime script dependency could not be traced.

E_RESERVED_FOLDER.summary: A reserved scripts/ folder shape was violated.

E_CSS_PREPROCESSOR_MISSING.summary: A CSS preprocessor is requested but not resolvable.

E_CSS_DEAD_REF.summary: A CSS url() points at nothing.

E_INTEGRATION_INSTALL.summary: A framework integration failed to install.

E_WAR_INVALID.summary: web_accessible_resources shape or match pattern rejected.

E_MATCH_PATTERN_INVALID.summary: The browser rejected a content-script match pattern.

E_BACKGROUND_REQUIRED.summary: The reload runtime needs a background chunk that is absent.

E_CONTENT_SCRIPT_SYNTAX.summary: A content script failed to parse.

E_REMOTE_RESOURCE_BLOCKED.summary: A remote script or stylesheet is blocked by extension CSP.

E_PERF_BUDGET.summary: An asset exceeds its size budget.

E_ZIP_SKIPPED.summary: Packaging was skipped for a stated reason.

E_REMOTE_FETCH_TIMEOUT.summary: A remote fetch exceeded its timeout.

E_REMOTE_DOWNLOAD.summary: Download or extraction of a remote extension failed.

E_REMOTE_ZIP_INVALID.summary: The remote URL did not return a zip.

E_LOCAL_ZIP_NOT_FOUND.summary: A referenced local zip is missing or not a zip.

E_PROJECT_DOWNLOAD_EMPTY.summary: Download succeeded but the extracted folder is absent.

E_NETWORK.summary: A network request failed or timed out.

E_BROWSER_NOT_FOUND.summary: No installed binary for the requested vendor.

E_BROWSER_BINARY_REQUIRED.summary: A -based target needs an explicit binary path.

E_BROWSER_BINARY_INVALID.summary: The given binary path does not exist or is not executable.

E_BROWSER_LAUNCH.summary: The browser process failed to spawn or died at startup.

E_BROWSER_EXITED.summary: The launched browser exited while the server kept running.

E_PROFILE_LOCKED.summary: The profile directory is held by another browser process.

E_LAUNCH_SKIPPED_COMPILE_ERRORS.summary: Launch was withheld because the compile failed.

E_INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS.summary: More than one live instance matches the requested id.

E_WSL_INTEROP.summary: WSL interop could not resolve a Windows browser.

E_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.summary: Downloading or installing a browser failed.

E_BROWSER_INSTALL_PRIVILEGE.summary: The install needs an interactive privileged session.

E_EXTENSION_LOAD_REFUSED.summary: The browser refused the unpacked extension.

E_BROWSER_CONNECT.summary: The debug connection could not be opened.

E_CDP_NOT_CONNECTED.summary: An operation was issued with no live CDP transport.

E_CDP_TIMEOUT.summary: A CDP command or load event timed out.

E_CDP_OP_FAILED.summary: An extension operation over CDP failed.

E_EXTENSION_ID_UNKNOWN.summary: The extension id could not be determined over CDP.

E_RDP_PROTOCOL.summary: A malformed or unexpected RDP exchange.

E_DEV_SERVER_START.summary: The dev server failed to start.

E_DEV_SERVER_TIMEOUT.summary: Dev server start exceeded its timeout.

E_PORT_IN_USE.summary: The requested port was taken and auto-reassigned.

E_PORT_UNAVAILABLE.summary: No free port could be bound near the requested one.

E_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.summary: No live session contract for this project and browser.

E_SESSION_EXISTS.summary: A live session already exists for this project and browser.

E_SESSION_STOPPED.summary: The session contract reports a stopped session.

E_READY_TIMEOUT.summary: --wait expired before the session became ready.

E_READY_ERROR_STATUS.summary: The ready contract reports an error for this session.

E_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE.summary: The control channel is absent, mismatched, or not answering.

E_CONTROL_DENIED.summary: The session refused the control operation.

E_TOKEN_MISSING.summary: The operation needs a session token that is not present.

E_EVAL_REFUSED.summary: Eval is disabled for the session or the token does not match.

E_TIMEOUT.summary: The operation did not answer inside its timeout.

E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.summary: The operation is not implemented for this context or engine.

E_TARGET_NOT_FOUND.summary: No tab, frame, or context matched the requested target.

E_EVAL.summary: The evaluated expression threw inside the page.

E_INSPECT.summary: DOM inspection failed inside the guest.

E_STORAGE.summary: chrome.storage rejected the read or write.

E_LOGS_NOT_FOUND.summary: No logs stream for this project and browser.

E_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.summary: The template is not in the catalog or has no manifest.

E_DESTINATION_NOT_EMPTY.summary: The destination already holds conflicting files.

E_DESTINATION_NOT_WRITABLE.summary: The destination directory is not writable.

E_CREATE_DIR.summary: The target directory could not be created.

E_CREATE_WRITE.summary: A scaffold file could not be written.

E_GIT_SKIPPED.summary: git init was skipped because git is absent.

E_PREVIEW_NO_DIST.summary: No unpacked extension at the resolved output path.

E_SAFARI_TOOLCHAIN.summary: The Safari toolchain is unavailable or an invocation failed.

E_AUTH_REQUIRED.summary: The operation needs an auth token that is not present.

E_TELEMETRY_WRITE.summary: The telemetry consent file could not be written.

E_DOCTOR_CHECKS_FAILED.summary: One or more doctor checks reported fail.

E_INTERRUPTED.summary: The operation was interrupted before it finished.

E_INTERNAL.summary: An unexpected fault reached the top-level sink.
